# EnergyWave

## Use



## Props (EnergyWaveProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `setName` * | `string` | Set name for the title ("Peak time Friday"). |
| `subtitle` * | `string` | Subtitle with track count, length and shape. |
| `slots` * | `EnergyWaveSlot[]` | Running order, slot 1 first. |
| `nowSlot` | `number` | 1-based slot playing now; omit when not playing. |
| `previewFrom` | `number` | 1-based first slot of a rebuild proposal; slots from here are hatched "Preview". |
| `onUsePreview` | `() => void` | Accept / discard handlers shown with a preview. |
| `onDiscardPreview` | `() => void` |  |
| `compact` | `boolean` | Compact height for saved-set cards. |
| `onSlotSelect` | `(index: number) => void` | Called with the slot index when a bar is activated (opens that row). |

### EnergyWaveSlot

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `track` * | `string` | Track shown in the tooltip and table ("Overmono – So U Kno"). |
| `energy` * | `number` | Energy 1–10 → `var(--energy-N)`. |
| `target` * | `number` | Target energy from the set shape for this slot. |
